title: Resistance Forces Raid Pyu Saw Htee Outpost in Kanbalu Township, Killing Seven
detail: Resistance fighters raided a pro-junta Pyu Saw Htee militia outpost near Pyin Taw Village, Kanbalu Township, Sagaing Region, reported September 25, 2026, killing approximately 7 militia members. Fighters seized 5 carbines, ammunition, equipment, helmets, magazines, and 5 motorcycles.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting the Pyu Saw Htee outpost raid near Pyin Taw Village.

title: Kalay Prison Political Detainees Face Acute Medical Neglect
detail: Roughly 80 prisoners at Kalay Prison, Sagaing Region — around 50 of them political prisoners — reportedly need urgent medical treatment, but only 9 have received outside care, amid shortages of medicine, oxygen, and equipment, per reporting published September 25, 2026.

media.caption: MoeMaKa CDM domestic news digest reporting on the medical crisis at Kalay Prison.
